name: Skinner v4.0.0 — Multi-Slot Character Customization, High-Res Midpoint KO Effects & Authentic Game Catalog
changelog: Multi-Slot Character Studio (Skin 1, Skin 2...): Create and switch between distinct modification setups per legend with persistent storage.
Crisp High-Res Midpoint KO Effect Previews: Renders exactly one peak action frame from the middle of the effect duration, eliminating distortion.
Missing & Ghost KO Effects Pruned: Dynamically filtered out non-existent effect symbols from the catalog.
Comprehensive Active Tab Preloading: Optimized loading screen to batch preload all active tabs for instant responsiveness.
100% Authentic Game Catalog Names: Replaced corrupted/internal identifiers with authentic in-game strings across all skins, weapons, and KO effects.
Cryptographic Verification: All release binaries signed with official Ed25519 digital key and protected by SHA-256 manifests.
